question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

As a jazz lover, I want people to embrace the music for its entrinsic qualities, not its symbolic resonance.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "entrinsic" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"intrinsic"**.

 
 
• **Example:** The** intrinsic **value of honesty cannot be overstated. (ईमानदारी का अंतर्निहित मूल्य अतुलनीय है।)
 
 
 
• **"Intrinsic"** means belonging naturally; essential. (अंतर्निहित)
 
 
• **Example:** The** intrinsic** beauty of the forest was breathtaking. (जंगल की अंतर्निहित सुंदरता अद्भुत थी।)
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **'intrinsic.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Qualities** (गुण): Attributes or characteristics possessed by someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** She has many admirable** qualities **that make her a great leader. (उसमें कई प्रशंसनीय गुण हैं जो उसे एक महान नेता बनाते हैं।)
 
 
 
• **Resonance** (अनुनाद): The quality in a sound of being deep, full, and reverberating.
 
 
• **Example:** The** resonance** of his voice filled the auditorium. (उसकी आवाज का अनुनाद सभागार में गूंज उठा।)
 
 
 
• **Embrace** (गले लगाना): To accept or support willingly and enthusiastically.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to** embrace** the new opportunities presented to her. (उसने अपने सामने प्रस्तुत नई संभावनाओं को गले लगाने का निर्णय लिया।)
